events.description: 50 failed login attempts detected from IP 192.168.1.100, indicating an automated credential-guessing or brute-force attack.
events.action: Block IP 192.168.1.100, temporarily lock targeted accounts, investigate source device for compromise, and enforce MFA.

events.description: An unusually large volume of data (15.5 GB) was downloaded from an internal IP address (10.0.0.55), indicating potential unauthorized data exfiltration or an insider threat.
events.action: Isolate IP 10.0.0.55 from the network, revoke active session tokens for the associated user account, and inspect data transfer logs to identify the compromised resources.

events.description: An internal host (172.16.0.200) performed a large-scale port scan across 1000 ports, indicating potential network reconnaissance from a compromised asset or insider threat.
events.action: Isolate host 172.16.0.200 from the network, investigate running processes on the instance, and review security logs for unauthorized access or subsequent exploit attempts.
